integrity: The infinite-prime-power classification is supported by an analytic determinant-and-cyclotomic proof; all finite enumeration results are stated only as supporting checks. Originality is assessed against identified literature without claiming exhaustive bibliographic coverage.
limitations: Prime-power cyclic Fourier orders strictly greater than five and only the row set {0,1,2,5}; ranks of four-column maximal minors, not their nonzero singular values or mixed-prime orders. An equivalent unindexed result remains possible.
title: Exact defect orbits of the four-row Fourier frame \(\{0,1,2,5\}\) at prime-power orders
